tool_args.rationale: The first five measurements vary only u_now at one gradient and horizon. The two open-branch measurements establish strong gradient dependence, but do not identify its functional form or distinguish a smooth bridge response from other coupled mechanisms. A fine trajectory batch is the remaining relevant measurement to constrain that response before fitting and confirming.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a stationary saturating model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch measurements show substantial gradient-dependent changes that the fixed-gradient u_now sweep cannot identify; the response law is still ambiguous.
The observations are smooth and coherent, not chaotic or evidence that all stationary mechanisms fail.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and would not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
